title: ISA에서 미국배당주 투자 vs 일반계좌 — 외국납부세액공제 한도
core_message: US dividend fund within Korean ISA faces foreign source withholding even while ISA domestic tax is deferred. Since 2025-07-01, foreign tax credit applied at ISA closure only for qualifying taxable dividends after ISA exemption, capped to domestic final tax. Domestic-listed US-investing ETFs may fit ISA, direct US listed stocks/ETFs not. 'ISA always best' is conditional.
